name: AltTextLab – Auto AI Alt Text Generator for SEO and accessibility
author: AltTextLab

sections.description:
AltTextLab – AI-Powered Alt Text Generator for WordPress

AltTextLab helps website owners and online stores improve SEO and accessibility by automatically adding meaningful, descriptive alt text to all images. Powered by advanced AI, the plugin supports bulk alt text generation, allowing you to optimize hundreds of images in just minutes — no manual work required.

🔍 Automatic Alt Text Generation
Every new image is analyzed and assigned AI-generated alt text that accurately reflects its content. It all happens automatically at upload — no extra effort needed.

⚡ Bulk Processing for Your Media Library
Generate alt text for your entire media library in just a few clicks. Save hours of work with fast and reliable batch generation.

📁 Supports All Major Image Formats
Compatible with JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, and AVIF, ensuring full support for today’s most common and modern image formats.

🛍 WooCommerce Integration
AltTextLab understands your product pages and smartly includes product names and brand in the alt text — boosting your store’s SEO performance.

🧩 SEO Plugin Integration
Works seamlessly with popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and others. Focus keyphrases are naturally included in the generated alt text.

🌍 Multi-language Support
Generate alt text in over 130 languages.

🚀 Easy Start & Free Trial
Get started in minutes with a simple installation and a free trial — no credit card required.

External services

This plugin connects to the API provided by AltTextLab.com to generate alt text for images using AI. This service is essential for the plugin’s core functionality.

What data is sent and when:

The plugin may send the following data to AltTextLab when generating alt text:
– The image URL or a base64-encoded version of the image
– Keywords
– The article or product title
– Brand and other relevant attributes, depending on plugin settings

The plugin may also send a request to fetch the current status of the connected AltTextLab account in order to display account information within the WordPress admin interface.

This external service is provided by AltTextLab.com. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “AltTextLab”.
  3. Click Install and then Activate the plugin.
  4. Sign up for a free trial or select a paid plan at alttextlab.com.
  5. Connect your account by entering your API key in the plugin settings.
  6. Upload an image — alt text will be generated automatically!
